generators.py.why: It uses a generator. Generators need stack switching, which WebAssembly doesn't have, so pyrock's browser build can't run it (the native executable can).

json_boundaries.py.why: It uses a CPython module, and a WebAssembly build can't embed CPython. On your machine pyrock compiles it in hybrid mode, with CPython at the boundaries Explain lists.

svg_double_pendulum.py.note: The pendulums are chaotic: WebAssembly's sin and cos round the last digit differently from CPython's math library, and the difference grows until a few late frames print one coordinate differently. The native executable matches CPython exactly.

type_error.py.why: pyrock rejects it at compile time: see the Check tab.
